# iOS UI Testability Contract

> An Agent Skills workflow and zero-dependency Python CLI for diagnosing iOS UI automation failures caused by missing or container-level accessibility identifiers, wrong XCUIElement types, unstable IDs, stale scenarios, and nondeterministic launch routes.

The CLI performs local static inventory and artifact triage. The agent skill interprets those findings with runtime UI evidence, makes the smallest app-side repair, and verifies the exact failing path. This project is not a general accessibility-conformance audit.

## CLI Surface

- `ios-ui-testability ids PATH`: inventory accessibility identifier risks in Swift and Objective-C source.
- `ios-ui-testability launch PATH`: inventory deterministic launch and routing hooks.
- `ios-ui-testability triage ...`: classify a failure bundle from its summary, UI tree, scenario, and optional planner validation error.
- `ios-ui-testability draft-context PATH`: draft planner-context guidance from discovered identifiers and launch hooks.
